Manual-only canonical Case Version-URL private preview.

Canonical Case authority: 9e8b37ec0a643aadf8aaf789e9ab6c4ae4b85cb3 (PR #104).
Dispatching the private-preview workflow checks an exact reviewed SHA locally,
uploads one undeployed Worker Version, and smokes only the Version URL returned
by Wrangler. It never promotes traffic, deploys production, applies D1
migrations, configures Telegram, enqueues funding work, or enables Rat/UI/media
flags. The existing live-smoke workflow remains a distinct, after-promotion
read-only gate.

The funding provenance migration
`20261002_pons_funding_provenance_v1.sql` remains a prerequisite to a full
Version-URL pass. Until separately authorized and applied, the fixed read-only
schema proof correctly stops at `FUNDING_SCHEMA_MISSING:*`.
